title: A $(24_4,32_3)$-configuration on the Schur quartic with logarithmic Chern slope $14/5$
summary: Let $X\subset\mathbb{P}^3$ be the Schur quartic \[ x_0^4-x_0x_1^3-x_2^4+x_2x_3^3=0. \] We exhibit a connected arrangement of $24$ lines on $X$, defined over $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-3})$, whose singular locus consists of $32$ ordinary triple points and no other intersections. Each line contains four triple points. The resulting reduced divisor $D$ satisfies $D\sim6H$, where $H$ is the hyperplane class.
